object.attr: derived: the GUI commit takes each changed file in the document's folder, so a PDF saved there is committed into the document, and each later export marks the document uncommitted (CF-P2; D-P23). The .git folder too, as for MCP (review Q21).
object.description: If the output path chosen in the save dialog is inside a document's folder or the repository's .git folder, the Document Editor shall ask for another output path.
